hotel_name: The St Regis Mardavall Mallorca Resort

claims.text: The resort is on the Carretera Palma-Andratx in Costa d'en Blanes, Palma de Mallorca.

findings.quote: Carretera Palma-Andratx 19, Costa d'en Blanes, Palma de Mallorca, Spain, 07181

claims.text: The resort is spread over four terracotta-toned buildings.

findings.quote: Spread over four terracotta-toned buildings

claims.text: Each room and suite has a private terrace or balcony, overlooking the Mediterranean Sea or the resort's gardens.

findings.quote: each overlooking the Mediterranean Sea or the resort's lush gardens. Each accommodation has a private terrace or balcony

claims.text: St. Regis Butler service is provided in all room types.

findings.quote: The anticipatory service of the St. Regis Butler ensures that each guest’s unique preferences are understood and realized.
Provided in all room types.

claims.text: The spa blends Eastern and Western therapies and includes Egyptian brine baths and an ice cave.

findings.quote: The spa blends Eastern and Western therapies with a holistic approach, 11 treatment rooms, whirlpool, dry sauna, Egyptian brine baths, ice cave and fitness center.

claims.text: Terra serves island flavors under the theme 'Recipes and products of Mallorca'.

findings.quote: Discover Terra's authentic island flavors with "Recipes and products of Mallorca"

claims.text: The resort's own take on the St. Regis Bloody Mary is the Mardavall Snapper, infused with island flavors.

findings.quote: Each hotel and resort within the St. Regis portfolio has crafted its own unique, locally inspired interpretation of the brand’s signature cocktail, the Bloody Mary.
Discover the Mardavall Snapper, infused with the vibrant flavors of the island.

claims.text: The Explorers Club offers daily programming for children; children who complete its tasks receive an Explorer's Certificate.

findings.quote: To take advantage of the daily programming at the Explorers Club
All children that have successfully solved the different tasks will receive at the end of their stay the title of "Official Explorer” as well as an Explorer’s Certificate

claims.text: Dogs and cats up to 11 kg are welcome.

findings.quote: We warmly welcome pets (dogs and cats) up to 11 kg at The St. Regis Mardavall.

claims.text: Through a collaboration with Gallery Red, the resort shows contemporary art, and a share of sales goes to the Mallorca Preservation Foundation.

findings.quote: collaboration with Gallery Red, we are honored to present a distinctive collection of contemporary art
benefiting the Mallorca Preservation Foundation, which will receive a share from the artworks sold.

claims.text: Es Fum is a Michelin-starred restaurant with a Sol Repsol, where chef Miguel Navarro cooks facing the Mediterranean.

findings.quote: Discover Es Fum, a Michelin-starred restaurant in Mallorca with a Sol Repsol, where chef Miguel Navarro creates flavors without borders facing the Mediterranean.

claims.text: Some residences, such as the St. Regis Pool Residence, have a private pool at garden level.

findings.quote: St. Regis Pool Residence
1 Bedroom Residence, 1 King, Garden view, Garden level, Private pool

claims.text: Mar Sea Club has a beachfront location and sea views, serving Mediterranean and Latin American flavors.

findings.quote: Mar Sea Club welcomes you with Mallorca-inspired design, a privileged beachfront location and sea views, where Mediterranean and Latin American flavors meet.

claims.text: Sabrage, opening champagne with a saber, is the signature ceremony of the St. Regis Evening Rituals, offered as a sunset celebration at the resort.

findings.quote: Dating back to the battles of Napoleon Bonaparte, who famously opened champagne with his saber in both victory and defeat, the art of sabrage is the signature ceremony of the St. Regis Evening Rituals series.
Experience your own sunset celebration at the St. Regis Mardavall.

claims.text: The resort offers an excursion that flies over Mallorca to Menorca, then continues by private yacht to Isla del Rey.

findings.quote: Discover Mallorca from above before crossing over to the enchanting island of Menorca. Upon arrival, embark on a private yacht to explore the captivating ‘sla del Rey
Isla del Rey in Menorca, accessible via an exclusive helicopter and boat journey

claims.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.

findings.quote: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

claims.text: Parents must remain on resort premises while their children attend the Explorers Club.

findings.quote: parents or caretakers must remain on resort premises at all times while their children are attending the Club.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the resort's exclusive positioning.
